Data:Slnev.hokobald.arun.json.startdescription: Arun strokes Hokobald's arm and whispers about the 'pleasures of the Princes'. Hokobald's response can best be described as 'angry curiosity.' [Lesson: Desires & Dissolutions]

Data:Slnev.hokobald.azita.json.startdescription: Hokobald challenges Azita to an arm-wrestling match. She accepts with enthusiasm. For the sake of decorum, they leave the room to conduct the match. When they return, it becomes apparent that Hokobald has won; but that his wrist is broken. 'That shouldn't happen! It should not be permitted!' he keeps whining, through gritted teeth. Azita only shrugs. [Lesson: Disciplines of the Hammer]

Data:Slnev.hokobald.chaima.json.startdescription: Hokobald has heard that Chaima had hunted and despatched an alukite in Tripoli a few months ago. He asks for details, which she provides. Her face is typically expressionless throughout. Hokobald asks, eyes glittering, if she has any trophies of the hunt. After a long pause, in which her face remains expressionless, she says that she does not. [Lesson: Disciplines of the Hammer]

Data:Slnev.hokobald.connie.json.startdescription: Hokobald grandiosely condescends to share information about the depredations of a Grail-long and associated coven in Maremma. Connie listens carefully, her expression neutral. [Lesson: Desires & Dissolutions]

Data:Slnev.hokobald.coquille.json.startdescription: Hokobald and Coquille continue their unnerving flirtation. She strokes his bald head and murmurs estimates of the measurements of the bones of her pelvis and rib-cage. [Lesson: Desires & Dissolutions]

Data:Slnev.hokobald.corso.json.startdescription: Corso has bought a Deep Mandaic cylinder seal as a gift for Hokobald - 'because, Magister, there are so few who might appreciate it.' While Hokobald is thus gratified, he brings out a collection of similar cylinder seals, and secures Hokobald's opinion and advice on their authenticity... [Lesson: Deep Mandaic]

Data:Slnev.hokobald.dagmar.json.startdescription: Hokobald has a proposal for a 'nine-arched wind-door' which he hopes to construct on Dagmar's estate. Dagmar is clearly interested in the project, but firmly refuses to let Hokobald use her estate, or even visit it. Hokobald grinds his teeth, but keeps his temper. [Lesson: Door & Wall]

Data:Slnev.hokobald.douglas.json.startdescription: Hokobald and Douglas remain wary of each other but, once again, find common ground in complaining about the Obliviates. They enjoy enumerating the Obliviates' crimes, grumble about how frustrating it is to see them tippy-toeing along the edge of the law, and agree they're a gang of hair-splitting snobs that want locking up. [Lesson: Ragged Crossroads]

Data:Slnev.hokobald.ehsan.json.startdescription: Hokobald and Ehsan discuss the origin of the Amiranis Beteli, the inscribed stone of secrets which fell from the sky, perhaps before the departure of the Cross. Ehsan believes the inscriptions were the work of Ys, after the meteorite struck the sea; Hokobald insists they were a 'Gleam-gift' from a Star (and also insists that Ehsan is a 'pug-faced lion-fewmet' when Ehsan dissents). [Lesson: Bells & Brazieries]

Data:Slnev.hokobald.fraser.json.startdescription: Hokobald negotiates the purchase, from Fraser, of certain exotic alloys. He presses Fraser on the availability of Ys-metal, but Fraser, glancing around nervously, insists that he can provide no such thing. [Lesson: Bells & Brazieries]

Data:Slnev.hokobald.morgen.json.startdescription: Hokobald attends Morgen with a kind of surly, lascivious obsequiousness, and she permits him to talk to her about the jewels he has brought for her, occasionally offering different opinions to which Hokobald pays due attention. At the end of the conversation, to his evident perplexity, she gives him a cabochon sapphire 'to hold on to.' [Lesson: Anbary & Lapidary]

Data:Slnev.hokobald.olympe.json.startdescription: Hokobald and Olympe share a series of peculiar meditations on chrysalides and crossroads. 'It will never be as it was,' she says, several times, softly. [Lesson: Resurgences & Emergences]

Data:Slnev.hokobald.serena.json.startdescription: Hokobald and Serena are speculating about the nature and possible identity of the still-nascent Hour referred to as the Chandler, who carries fire in darkness; who leaves a place without entering it; whose endeavours are profitable. Serena thinks it possible the Chandler may manifest through the New King. Hokobald shakes his great head. 'A Name attends him, certainly. But no more than a Name.' [Lesson: Transformations & Liberations]

Data:Slnev.hokobald.stanislav.json.startdescription: Stanislav presses Hokobald on those qualities that the Name Kitling Ripe finds tasty - that the Velvet might reward their bearers with immortality, to make prey for her pet. Hokobald gives him some details, but asks abruptly whether Stanislav hopes to grow Long. Stanislav will not answer; Hokobald delivers a lecture in which he laments his own immortality, and wishes that he had died following the plough in Uffington. (But perhaps Hokobald has been drinking.) Stanislav asks whether he might not mean 'Pocsind', not 'Uffington', and Hokobald changes the subject. [Lesson: Spices & Savours]

Data:Slnev.hokobald.visiting.denzil.json.startdescription: Hokobald condescendingly shares some his personal theories on the 'Great Debasement', and its metallurgical consequences. Denzil chews his food slowly and says nothing at all. [Lesson: Bells & Brazieries]

Data:Slnev.hokobald.visiting.killes.json.startdescription: Hokobald asks Mr Kille whether he works with other materials than wood. Mr Kille gets up, bows deeply, says that he regrets that he does not, and leaves the room for several minutes. When he returns, he is careful not to sit near Hokobald.

Data:Slnev.hokobald.visiting.timothy.jso.startdescription: Hokobald has questions on the stained glass windows in the chapel of Hush House, and their depictions of the Hours. Reverend Timothy - who has long been passionately interested in the history and architecture of the House - is eager to share what he knows, but is clearly nervous that Hokobald may have some ulterior interest. Hokobald, however, evinces nothing but genuine (if condescending) curiosity. [Lesson: Glaziery & Lightsmithing]

Data:Slnev.hokobald.yvette.json.startdescription: Hokobald demands to know whether Yvette ever hears the bells of Ys when she's near the sea. Yvette bridles at his tone, but answers carefully that she thinks perhaps that she might; they discuss what form the sounds might take, and Hokobald's brusqueness softens a little. [Lesson: Bells & Brazieries]

Data:Slnev.hokobald.zachary.json.startdescription: Hokobald insists impatiently to Zachary that it is a crime not to yield to his 'burgeoning nature', and that he should 'get on with the devouring.' Zachary firmly but quietly dissents. [Lesson: The Great Signs and the Great Scars]

Data:Slnev.morgen.agdistis.json.startdescription: Morgen and Agdistis discuss the folk-songs of Umbria and their connection to the Twins. It transpires that they both met Christopher Illopoly during his year in Italy as a young man. Morgen wonders where he might be, and Agdistis blurts out impulsively: 'Stay away from him!' He immediately blanches at his own boldness, but Morgen seems entertained. [Lesson: Strings & Songs]

Data:Slnev.morgen.aladim.json.startdescription: Morgen and al-Adim compare their experiences of the notorious blossoms of the City of Messenger Eagles, which they have both visited, although, it seems, their visits were almost two hundred years apart... [Lesson: Orchids & Narcotics]

Data:Slnev.morgen.arthur.json.startdescription: Morgen presses Arthur again on the 'Flaw in the Glass' identified in the enclosure of a sacred flame at the Labyrinth of Lions - and on its connection to the Chandler. He is on his guard this time, but he does allow that a connection might 'come alive' with sufficient Lantern and Knock - and that this is why the Labyrinth permits no Knock-adepts to enter the enclosure. [Lesson: Glaziery & Lightsmithing]

Data:Slnev.morgen.arun.json.startdescription: Morgen and Arun return to their conversation about the Obliviates, who once were called the House of Lethe. She playfully accuses him of being a member, and asks him where he keeps his three chains. He parries by asking her where she keeps her notorious key of black sapphire. Morgen crosses her legs and asks Arun silkily if he would like to search her. After a moment, he says very definitely that no, he would not. [Lesson: Sacra Limiae]

Data:Slnev.morgen.azita.json.startdescription: Morgen teases Azita with references to 'Medusa's Lament', which purports to describe the death of the god-from-stone Seven-Coils at the hands of the Colonel, Azita's patron. [Lesson: Horns & Ivories]

Data:Slnev.morgen.chaima.json.startdescription: Chaima says: if I wished to enter the House of the Moon, would you open the door for me. Morgen responds, as if it were a ritual: why do you wish to enter the House of the Moon? Chaima says: if my prey entered the House of the Moon, and I claimed the rights of the hunter. Morgen responds: I will always honour the rights of the hunter. [Lesson: Sky Stories]

Data:Slnev.morgen.connie.json.startdescription: Connie asks business-like questions about a didumos - the twin or reflection of a star - that she fears may have been employed to commit crimes-of-dream. She suspects it has taken refuge in the Mansus-shadow called the House of the Moon. Morgen, answering with surprising frankness, nevertheless makes it clear to Connie that the Suppression Bureau will never be able to follow it into the House of the Moon - and that she will under no circumstances help them try. [Lesson: Ouranoscopy]

Data:Slnev.morgen.coquille.json.startdescription: Morgen and Coquille almost seem to be getting on well, until Morgen enquires sweetly about Coquille's 'last father'. Coquille flushes: 'In excellent health,' she says, 'and your last child?' She clearly repents it the moment the words are out of her mouth. She excuses herself from the room to 'take the air', while Morgen watches her leave with eyes like glinting silver nails. [Lesson: Desires & Dissolutions]

Data:Slnev.morgen.corso.json.startdescription: Corso has read conflicting accounts of traditional means of mixing the Sacrament Calicite. He asks Morgen, as an 'ambassadress of the Grail', for her opinions. She objects to the characterisation - 'ambassadress of the Witch, perhaps, on a clear night at least' - but does share her clearly informed opinions. [Lesson: Applebright Euphonies]

Data:Slnev.morgen.dagmar.json.startdescription: Morgen tells a fascinated Dagmar the tale of the one time she tried, and failed, to reach the city of Ys, by binding her ship to a debauched messenger of the lower skies… [Lesson: Sea Stories]

Data:Slnev.morgen.douglas.json.startdescription: Morgen discusses occult-adjacent cookery with Douglas, intermittently suggesting hypothetical ingredient-people (a fraudulent bishop; a Knock-cultist amputee) that she might include, and how fervently the Bureau would pursue her in these hypothetical cases. Douglas struggles to keep his temper.  [Lesson: Spices & Savours]

Data:Slnev.morgen.ehsan.json.startdescription: Morgen and Ehsan discuss the motives of the aviform Hours. Ehsan is firm in his belief that they are fundamentally benevolent to mortals; Morgen says smilingly: 'Perhaps then you know the Twins better than do I.' [Lesson: Strings & Songs]

Data:Slnev.morgen.fraser.json.startdescription: Morgen insists on the superiority of cats to dogs. Fraser insists on the inferiority of cats to bees. [Lesson: Furs & Feathers]

Data:Slnev.morgen.hokobald.json.startdescription: Last time, Morgen gave Hokobald a cabochon sapphire; he now returns it, sneering at the obviousness of her 'trap'. His manner towards her has changed from surly obsequiousness to surly menace, although the lascivious undertone remains. Morgen insists laughingly that it was 'only a little game,' and though Hokobald plainly doesn't believe her, he decides in the end to accept the excuse - perhaps for the sake of their tenuous alukite un-kinship. [Lesson: Anbary & Lapidary]

Data:Slnev.morgen.olympe.json.startdescription: Morgen repeats half-remembered fragments of Ramsund that the wind brought her when she was sailing. Olympe translates them for her. [Lesson: Ramsund]

Data:Slnev.morgen.serena.json.startdescription: Morgen and Serena discuss the parallels, and the alliances, between Hours and heavenly bodies. [Lesson: Ouranoscopy]

Data:Slnev.morgen.stanislav.json.startdescription: Morgen asks Stanislav, gaily and lightly, about 'Three Faces', the guardian of the Grove of Green Immortals, where Stanislav is reputed to have spent time. Stanislav replies respectfully, urbanely, and eliptically. [Lesson: Orchids & Narcotics]

Data:Slnev.morgen.visiting.denzil.json.startdescription: Morgen continues to ignore Denzil, who maintains a safe distance, casting occasional sullen, wary glances in her direction

Data:Slnev.morgen.visiting.killes.json.startdescription: Once again, Mrs Kille addresses Morgen as 'Chaculette', and once again, Morgen kisses her finger and touches Mrs Kille's forehead. (Mr Kille watches from a careful distance.) They both make small talk for some minutes, until Mrs Kille asks Morgen if she has ever considered 'Medea's path'. A silvery sadness glints in Morgen's eyes; she says that it is barred to her, and unexpectedly quotes a passage from the Book of Suns about the commission of sins in twilight... [Lesson: Resurgences & Emergences]

Data:Slnev.morgen.visiting.timothy.json.startdescription: From the moment Morgen saunters into the room, Timothy stares at her like an arachnophobe confronted with a moseying tarantula. She is clearly aware of it, and ignores him for the first half hour. At this point she turns to fix her gaze on him and abruptly claps her hands: he kicks over his chair, stumbles apologising in the direction of the toilet, and does not return for some time.

Data:Slnev.morgen.yvette.json.startdescription: Morgen seems taken with Yvette, and devotes more attention to her than Yvette seems comfortable with. When Yvette falls silent, Morgen raises her silvery voice in a silvery song. The tune is jaunty; but the words are Killasimi; and by the end of it, even Morgen seems distraught. 'I wish, sometimes, that I might still weep,' she confides. [Lesson: Killasimi]
